title: Mean of the correlated pair sum
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $a=(a_i)_{i=1}^n$ be real coefficients. Draw a uniform sign vector $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, then form $y$ by independently at each coordinate keeping $x_i$ with probability $(1+\rho)/2$ and flipping it otherwise. The expected value of the sum of vectors $(a_i x_i,a_i y_i)\in\mathbb R^2$ over all coordinates $i$ is the zero vector.
hypotheses_covered: real coefficient function on Fin n
